info.title: Home Center 0.60 Parental Internet Read API
info.description: Authenticated parent-authorized read surface for saved parental Internet Desired State and side-effect-free decision previews. Policy identity and rule-source identity are always resolved server-side. Preview output is not provider enforcement evidence, Actual State, or execution authority.

200.description: Current saved parental policy projection or an explicit absent state; no provider execution authority

503.description: Saved/verified policy state is invalid or unavailable

post.description: Same-origin read-only preview. The server supplies current policy and rule-source identity; caller facts cannot authorize DNS/proxy execution.

200.description: UI preview bound to current protected Desired State and exact verified 0.59 base; enforcement_verified remains false

403.description: Parent/Household administration authority or same-origin requirement not satisfied

404.description: Household/member or saved parental Desired State not found

503.description: Verified 0.59 base or current saved parental state is stale/invalid
